numeric_facts.label: Plasma proteins
numeric_facts.scope: Source-wide SWATH-MS plasma protein inventory; per-person completeness is not established by this count.

numeric_facts.label: PBMC transcripts
numeric_facts.scope: PBMC transcript inventory measured by RNA sequencing; not independent genes or complete transcripts in every person.

numeric_facts.label: Plasma metabolites
numeric_facts.scope: Plasma metabolite inventory from untargeted LC-MS/MS; per-person completeness is not established.

numeric_facts.label: Serum cytokines / growth factors
numeric_facts.scope: Serum cytokine and growth-factor assay targets reported in the study; no independent-information interpretation.

numeric_facts.label: Measured glycan peaks
numeric_facts.scope: Measured glycan peaks from electropherograms; peaks can include more than one glycan structure.

numeric_facts.label: Derived glycan traits
numeric_facts.scope: Calculated glycan traits sharing structural features; not additional independently acquired targets.

numeric_facts.label: Unique plasma proteins
numeric_facts.scope: 2923 unique proteins in the UKB Olink panel across 54219 people; distinct from 2941 analytes, with incomplete/variable sample coverage.

numeric_facts.label: Median observed span
numeric_facts.scope: Median observed span per participant across the iPOP cohort; not a uniform treatment duration.

numeric_facts.label: Median visits per person
numeric_facts.scope: Median profiled visits per participant, including healthy and stress-event visits.

numeric_facts.label: Typical healthy-sampling interval
numeric_facts.scope: Typical three-month healthy sampling schedule; actual individual visit gaps may differ.

numeric_facts.label: Short-regimen treatment span
numeric_facts.scope: Three-month TPE regimen with two sessions during the first week of each monthly cycle.

numeric_facts.label: Monthly-regimen sessions
numeric_facts.scope: Six sessions in the monthly TPE regimen; treatment count differs from blood-sampling occasions.

numeric_facts.label: Accelerometer wear window
numeric_facts.scope: Seven-day wrist accelerometer wear window in a UK Biobank subset, not continuous years of sensing.
